create.name: Kaine Stromberg
create.bio:
Kaine Stromberg is a mentor and meditation guide based in Ipswich, England, whose work centres on the hidden beliefs and inherited patterns that quietly steer how people live. He came to it through his own story: a difficult relationship with his father, years of carrying old hurt, and the turning point of becoming a father himself, a journey he shares in a short documentary film. He is also involved in Man Kind Movement CIC, a community group in Ipswich where men meet to talk openly and back one another up.

On Insight Timer he records long hypnotic and guided meditations on self-worth, connecting with the higher self, cord cutting, grounding and the divine masculine, along with week-long audio courses. Away from the app he works mainly online under the name MentorShift: one-to-one mentoring over several months, a twelve-week group programme called Live On Purpose, and shorter self-paced material. His approach weaves together subconscious reprogramming, affirmation, emotional awareness and meditation, aiming to help people, and men in particular, feel at home in themselves rather than chasing outward success.

courses.title: Live On Purpose (12-week group programme)
courses.description: A twelve-week group journey that works through self-worth, boundaries, personal power, self-acceptance and finally vision and purpose. It combines structured weekly themes with group support and accountability; places are arranged after a free discovery call.

courses.title: True Success & Meaningful Fulfilment (1:1 mentorship)
courses.description: Six months of private mentoring for people ready to look at the beliefs and habits running in the background of their lives. Sessions focus on self-awareness, emotional intelligence and identity, and entry is by application after an introductory call.

courses.title: Before You Reach For It: The 7 Steps to a Better You
courses.description: A short self-paced process in seven steps for noticing automatic reactions in the moment and choosing a calmer, more conscious response instead. It is a one-off purchase with a 30-day guarantee.

courses.title: Activate Your True Self-Worth & Start Enjoying A Life Of True Happiness Today
courses.description: A seven-day audio course on Insight Timer, around half an hour a day, pairing short teachings with guided meditations and simple daily tasks. It moves through old beliefs, letting go of past ties, handwritten affirmations, the higher self and gratitude.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Kaine Stromberg on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page holds dozens of free recordings, many of them long hypnotic meditations on self-worth, letting go, the higher self and connecting with angels. All of the single tracks can be played at no cost.

free_resources.title: The Perfect Daily Routine
free_resources.description: A free guide and audio for a morning routine of under twenty minutes, set out as a seven-day reset to begin the day with more intention.

free_resources.title: Fill The Void Inside
free_resources.description: A free PDF that helps you notice the sense that something is missing and look at the thoughts and patterns underneath it.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 6.1k (profile, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram 28K (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube 121 subscribers (channel header next to @KaineStromberg); Facebook count not readable -> ~34k total -> local_hero
flags: Mainly a life coach and mentor on his own site (MentorShift, men's work, corporate 'Human Performance'); the spiritual side (higher self, quantum healing, DNA activation, angels) is mostly on Insight Timer and YouTube. A human may want to judge fit.
Email chat@kainestromberg.com is published on the Human Performance (corporate) page, not on his contact page, which only offers a discovery call.
Many Insight Timer tracks and courses are sold on conditions (anxiety, addiction, pain, sleep, smoking) and his quantum healing course page claims health benefits; these were all left out.
Based in Ipswich and involved in Man Kind Movement CIC (local men's groups), but his own paid work appears to be online, so availability is worldwide.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
Instagram account is titled 'A State Of Mind' (@kainestromberg), his brand name.
left_out: Insight Timer courses 'Busy Mind? - Stop Overthinking And Reduce Anxiety', 'Inner-Child Healing Full: Completly Heal Your Inner-Child', 'Fall Asleep With Ease & Enjoy A Week Of Perfect Sleep' (condition/healing claims), 'Quantum Healing, Shifting & Highest Timeline Activation' (course page claims physical health benefits) and 'Fully Activate All Strands OF Your DNA' (borderline biological claim).
The Missing Piece 8-day programme ($33): last cohort started 15 October, already past.
YouTube: stop-smoking, anxiety, sleep, stress and father/mother wound 'healing' meditations; dated New Year and 1 April chakra videos; short vlogs and promos.
Self-Control Mini Course and 'how to stop addiction' page (addiction framing).
Human Performance corporate team training (not spiritual teaching).
